|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[The Force Will Be With You, Always]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[The Force Will Be With You, Always (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 9 October 2026<ref name="ht-1f401ba">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual27-Light/large/theforcewillbewithyoualways.gif</code> as published 9 October 2026: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1f401ba5a2c0ecb415b43001cefdb9a2f226553b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Light/large/theforcewillbewithyoualways.gif holotable commit 1f401ba] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “If a Jedi 'communing,' choose: Take Coruscant: Jedi Temple into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Once per game, draw bottom card of your Force Pile. OR Once per game, take your just drawn destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Force Will Be With You, Always (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”; file created 13 October 2026). Released with [[Virtual Set 27]] (9 October 2026); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 5, file created 13 October 2026: “If a Jedi 'communing,' choose: Take Coruscant: Jedi Temple into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Once per game, draw bottom card of your Force Pile. OR Once per game, take your just drawn destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[The Force Will Be With You, Always]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[The Force Will Be With You, Always]] (published 9 October 2026) as a printable slip under the label “•The Force Will Be With You, Always”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
